reports.title: AMN HEALTHCARE ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section:
Metric | Guidance*
Consolidated revenue | $655 - $670 million
Gross margin | 25.7% - 26.2%
SG&A as percentage of revenue | 21.2% - 21.7%
Operating margin | (0.1%) - 0.5%
Adjusted EBITDA margin | 5.8% - 6.3%

Revenue in the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be 10-12% lower than the prior year. This outlook assumes labor disruption revenue of $5 million this quarter compared with $124 million in Q4 2025. Nurse and Allied Solutions segment revenue is expected to be down 13-15% year over year, or up 13-15% excluding labor disruption. Physician and Leadership Solutions segment revenue is expected to be down 5-7% year over year. Technology and Workforce Solutions segment revenue is projected to be down 8-10% year over year.

Fourth quarter estimates for certain other financial items include depreciation of $12.5 million, depreciation in cost of revenue of $2.5 million, amortization expense of $15.5 million, share-based compensation expense of $6 million, integration and other expenses of $2 million, interest expense of $8.5 million, marginal adjusted tax rate of 28%, and 40.1 million diluted average shares outstanding.
